messages:
ops-bot: NOTICE: brief customer-impacting event in us-west-2 affecting a subset of hosted runtimes. Symptoms: elevated latency and occasional 502s for large-batch embedding requests. Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1701112222 :triangular_flag_on_post:

elliot: seeing memory growth on embed-worker pool after a nightly job. OOMs causing restarts and HTTP 502s from edge-proxy. sample log:
```
OOM killed process embed-worker-12 (rss=14.3G)
edge-proxy: upstream returned 502 for 10.23.5.12
```

vivian: rolling back last night's embed-optimizer deploy to stop the leak. command: `deploy revert embed-optimizer --region us-west-2 --to v1.2.4`

eng-support: drafting customer note: "We observed elevated errors for embedding requests in us-west-2. We rolled back a recent optimizer and are monitoring."

infra: mitigation actions applied:
- rolled back embed-optimizer to v1.2.4 on the affected ASG
- cordoned and drained two noisy hosts for postmortem capture
- increased autoscale min nodes by 2 to absorb load
- enabled a temporary per-tenant request cap for large embeddings

elliot: after rollback, restarts stopped and error rate back to baseline on rolled-back instances. p95 latency improving. continuing to watch for 15m.

ops-bot: Incident page (live): https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1701112222 — updates posted there.

vivian: next steps: reproduce leak in staging with the optimizer, add memory guardrails and eviction instrumentation, and schedule a postmortem ticket (ENG-4591). customer comms to be sent after 10m stable baseline.

eng-support: support team on watch for replies; flagging enterprise customers for proactive outreach.

elliot: closing note: if you see any reappearance tag `@oncall` immediately and upload logs to the incident artifacts folder. :white_check_mark:
